task.description:
WF-03 Step 3 for ISS-0910. Implement lib/letflow/design/iss0910-role-backfill-resync-marker-reset.md's PASSed design in full: for every tenant in RoleBackfill.run/0's own :seeded list, bulk-reset role_claims_synced_at to nil for that tenant's users via Repo.update_all(User, [set: [role_claims_synced_at: nil]], prefix: schema_name), in a separate transaction from the tenant_role/group seeding (per the design's OQ-1, this gap is accepted, not something to silently fix beyond the design's own scope). Extend run/0's return value with a role_claims_markers_reset counter, and update the mix task CLI wrapper (lib/mix/tasks/letflow.backfill_platform_roles.ex) to surface it.

Run: `mix compile --warnings-as-errors`, `mix format --check-formatted`, and the existing role_backfill test suite (find it -- likely test/letflow/identity/role_backfill_test.exs) plus a Docker-provisioned or local-toolchain DB migration check if needed. Self-review per your role's checklist: no string interpolation of tenant/user input into raw SQL, no unresolved {:ok, _} = match on an external-I/O-reachable path, new function has a @doc, any changed function signature's call sites still compile.
acceptance_criteria: the fix resets role_claims_synced_at to nil for users with a membership in each tenant in RoleBackfill.run/0's own :seeded list, not :unchanged tenants
the reset reuses sync_role_claims_from_token/3's existing gated call sites (no new sync-triggering code path invented)
the fix is idempotent -- running the backfill twice does not error and does not incorrectly re-affect already-corrected users
